title: Heatstroke — लू लगना
warning: Heatstroke is life-threatening. Call 108. Cool the person while waiting for help.

steps.instruction: Move person to shade or cool area immediately. Remove excess clothing.
Cool them rapidly: wet their skin with cool water, fan vigorously.
steps.hint: Fastest cooling = wet clothes and fanning. Do NOT use ice water.

steps.instruction: Apply cool wet cloths to neck, armpits, and groin — where blood vessels are close to skin.
steps.hint: These areas cool the blood quickly

steps.instruction: If conscious, give cool water to sip slowly. Do NOT give if unconscious.
Do NOT give aspirin or paracetamol — they do not help in heatstroke.
Monitor breathing. If unconscious, place in recovery position (on their side).
Continue cooling until temperature drops or ambulance arrives. Go to hospital.
